physical: Every continuous symmetry of the action corresponds to a conserved quantity: time translation to energy, space translation to momentum, rotation to angular momentum, phase to charge.
reflected_sentence: No complete reflection has frozen vocabulary partners.
rule_reason: An identity connecting symmetries and conservation keeps, with no resistance costs.
closing: The rule decides keeps, but mapping time to Expansion and space to Vibration does not map their translation operations. Energy and lowercase momentum have partners; angular momentum and charge do not. Capitalized Momentum would improperly replace a conserved quantity with an entity property.
